build.beforeDevCommand: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "`$root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim(); if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & npm.cmd run dev --prefix (Join-Path `$root 'ui')"
build.beforeBuildCommand: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "`$root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim(); if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & npm.cmd run build --prefix (Join-Path `$root 'ui'); exit `$LASTEXITCODE"
